description: On the red surface in front of you are a blue plate, a small light-green tray, a green triangular piece, a wooden strip with two holes, a white block, and a small blue cube near the right side. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the blue cube as a right-hand object, lifts it slightly, moves it leftward over the blue plate, and then lowers and releases it onto the center of the plate, leaving the hand hovering above.
